blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The defense lawyers of former President Rodrigo Duterte are opposing the admission of two supplemental studies cited by a prosecution expert witness, arguing that the materials lack substance. In an Oct. 30 filing released only on Saturday, the defense asked Trial Chamber III (TC III) to reject the prosecution’s request to admit […]...
